pack_rectangles: pack a list of rectangle sizes into a single bounding box allowing 90 degree rotation
pack_unique_rectangles: pack rectangles deduplicated by identifier into a single bounding box with 90 degree rotation allowed
create_Rectangle: create a Rectangle named tuple with xsize, ysize, and identifier for rectangle packing input
create_PackedRectangle: create a PackedRectangle named tuple with x, y position, flipped flag, and is_first flag
create_PackedRectangles: create a PackedRectangles named tuple with total bounding box size and list of packed rectangle locations
